rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something will happen soon.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zau6 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for something happening in a little while, especially later in the same day.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 zoi3 daa2 bei2 nei5

rows.note: Use this when the event is imminent or very soon to happen.

example.jyutping: bou6 ce1 zau6 faai3 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that something will happen quickly rather than merely at an early time.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 faai3 zau6 zou6 jyun4
